conditions.displayName: An error from submitEnquiry or enquiryProbe

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name=("submitenquiry" OR "enquiryprobe" OR "newhorses" OR "subscriberscleanup") AND severity>=ERROR

documentation.content: A sink, the Turnstile secret or the daily probe failed. The log line names which one. A real enquiry may still be in `/enquiries` or in the shared mailbox (#49).
